verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs say traces can be exported via the UI or API, a first-party export capability for traces. Nothing shows bulk export, blob storage or warehouse destinations, or dataset export. The OpenTelemetry Collector fanout and self-hosting items are adjacent infrastructure, not an export feature, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented bulk export jobs, blob storage (e.g. S3/GCS) or data warehouse destinations, dataset export, format/scheduling details, independent corroboration.
